findings.problem: The voice says 'A as root five and B as root three', but only the colours show this. A student who has not matched orange to a and blue to b may not link the rule note to the bottom of the line.
findings.fix: On 'A as root' and 'B as root', write a = √5, b = √3 in the same orange and sky. Add it to the existing rule note's line rather than as a new note under a line, so the 640-tall window still fits.
